title: fix(fields): ImageField names a nameless image with the translated fields.image.imageAlt, not the literal 'Image' (objectui#10637)
body:
Fixes #10637

Clause-②: no

## What changed

`ImageField` read its images with `readFileValues(value, 'Image')`. `readFileValue` puts that fallback name on every value that carries no name of its own (a bare `sys_file` id, a `data:` URI), so `img.name` was the truthy English word `Image`, and each `img.name || t('fields.image.imageAlt', ...)` in the widget stopped at it on every locale. The translated fallback never ran.

- `packages/fields/src/widgets/ImageField.tsx`: the one `readFileValues` call now passes `''` as the fallback name, as the image cell's `displayableImagesOf` has since objectui#10493, plus a comment saying why. No other line of the widget changed: every reader of the view's name already falls through on an empty name. `file-value.ts` is not touched, per the triage ruling.
- `packages/fields/src/widgets/ImageField.imageAlt-10637.test.tsx` (new): the pin.
- `.changeset/10637-image-alt-translated.md` (new): `patch` for `@object-ui/fields`.

### Every reader of the name in `ImageField` (dispatch H3, measured)

For a value with no name of its own:

| Reader | Base | After |
|---|---|---|
| read-only `img` alt | `Image` | translated `fields.image.imageAlt`, indexed by position |
| read-only enlarge button's `aria-label` | `fields.image.enlarge` naming `Image` | `fields.image.enlarge` embedding the translated alt |
| edit-mode thumbnail alt | `Image` | translated alt, indexed |
| lightbox dialog's accessible name (its title) | `Image` | translated `fields.image.preview` |
| lightbox `img` alt | `Image` | translated alt, indexed |
| cropper output file name (`openCropper`) | `Image` | `image-0.png` for the first image |
| a just-uploaded image stored as a bare id (`withRecentUploads`) | its upload name | its upload name, unchanged |

The lightbox row follows the cell exactly: the lightbox gets no name and uses its own translated fallbacks, `fields.image.imageAlt` for the image and `fields.image.preview` for the dialog title. `ImageLightbox` is unchanged. The dispatch's pin shape said the lightbox name would be the `fields.image.imageAlt` text. Measured, the dialog's accessible name comes from its title, so the pin asserts the translated preview title for the dialog and the translated alt for its image.

The cropper row is a side effect of the fix, not its purpose. `image-${index}.png` was already the widget's fallback in `openCropper`, and it was unreachable for the same reason as the translated alt. It was measured with a throwaway probe, never committed, that mocked the cropper dialog to expose its `outputName`: base `Image`, after `image-0.png`. A value with its own name read `cover.png` on both trees. The name reaches `original_name` on the legacy-blob submit path and the oversize and failed-upload messages. It is not pinned.

## Measured

Base = `f99f9cd`.

| Run | Tree | Result | Exit |
|---|---|---|---|
| the pin before the fix | base plus the new pin file | 6 failed, 4 passed | 1 |
| the pin with the fix | `adb443f` | 10 passed | 0 |
| the pin at the final head | `d139941` | 10 passed | 0 |

Base readings from those failures: under `zh`, a bare id's alt was `Image` where the zh pack's `fields.image.imageAlt` for index 1 was expected, in read-only and in edit mode. The lightbox dialog's accessible name was `Image`. Two bare ids read `Image`, `Image`. A data URI read `Image`. Under `en` the alt was `Image` where the pack gives `Image 1`. The four rows that passed on the base are the premise row and three controls: a value with its own name, an https URL, and a just-uploaded image stored as a bare id.

Every expected string in the pin comes from the imported `en` or `zh` pack, interpolated in the test. None is typed by hand. The premise row asserts that the two packs differ and that the zh strings do not contain `Image`.

## Tests and gates

The union was run after the final commit, at `d139941`. That head merges `origin/main` at `785d3a7`, which brought objectui#10653's `file-value.ts` change. Its `nameFromUrl` edit does not interact with the fallback name.

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/fields/`: 210 files passed and 1 skipped, 3409 tests passed and 7 skipped, exit 0.
- `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/fields --concurrency=2`: 12 of 12 tasks successful, exit 0. `@object-ui/fields:type-check` was a cache miss and executed. The package's `type-check` chains `tsconfig.test.json`, and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the new pin once (control: `ImageField.maxSize.test.tsx` is also listed once).
- eslint, plain form with `--no-inline-config`, on the two changed source and test files: exit 0, 0 errors, 7 warnings, all in `ImageField.tsx`. They are the same rule set as the base blob: 4 `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any`, 1 `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps`, 2 `react-hooks/preserve-manual-memoization`. Their messages differ from the base only by the line numbers they embed, which the 8 added comment lines shift. This narrowed run is a measurement, not a skipped check, on three counts. (1) The population comes from `eslint.config.js`, whose `**/*.{ts,tsx}` block covers both files. (2) The `--format json` output lists exactly 2 files. (3) Invariance: the config enables no type-aware parsing (0 hits for `projectService|parserOptions|project:|TypeChecked`, against 9 hits for `files:` as a control), and no rule under `eslint-rules/` imports `fs`. So this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.
- Exit 0 on each of: `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` (a report; a grep of its output finds no `fields.image.*` key, and the same grep does find `engine.quickfind.empty`, a key it lists), `check:unreferenced-sources`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` and `node scripts/check-changeset-overwrite.mjs`. The last five are added to the dispatch's list, derived from the diff: the i18n call sites it sits beside, a new test file, and the changeset workflow's two gates.

Round 2: merged `origin/main` at `7baede3` (objectui#10677, which carries the change for the objectui#10645 test) into the branch with no conflicts, giving head `af4162e`. At that head the pin (10 passed), `pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/` (211 files passed and 1 skipped, 3419 tests passed and 7 skipped) and `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/fields` (12 of 12) each exit 0 (os-dev-report round 2, comment `5836466253`).

## Acceptance notes

- `FileValueView.name`'s doc in `file-value.ts` gives the image cell as the caller that asks for an empty fallback. `ImageField` now asks too. The doc stays true, because it names the cell as an example and not as the only caller. It is left alone, because the ruling keeps `file-value.ts` out of this change.
- `uploadResultView` names a result `File` when both the result's name and the original name are empty. `ImageField` never reaches that: its two upload paths always pass a name (the picked file's, or the cropper's).
- No governed surface is touched.
